title.narrative: European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) phase II: Support for The GloPID-R Secretariat

description.narrative: Support to develop the creation of Pandemic Analytical Capacity and Funding Tracking Programme (Pandemic PACT) database which build on the COVID CIRCLE research tracker established during the COVID-19 pandemic. Pandemic PACT will develop a research funding tracking and analysis capability for a range of emerging infections, in particular focussed on those primariliy affection low and middle-income country poulations, with the outputs linked to major funders, decision makers and WHO.

The UK Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) funds outstanding global health research through the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR). The NIHR provided funding to European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) which aims to support collaborative research that accelerates the clinical development of new or improved interventions to prevent or treat poverty related as well as emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases affecting sub-Saharan Africa. NIHR has supported the research as part of the the Global Research Collaboration for Infectious Diseases Preparedness (GloPID-R) Secretariat on Pandemic Preparedness: Analytical Capacity and Funding Tracking programme (Pandemic PACT). This activity is a component of European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) phase II programme (GB-GOV-10-EDCTP2).
